yorum: We had a hard time finding the hotel by car. The GPS pointed us to the lower part of the hotel, while the parking entrance and reception were upstairs. There were no signs there, only by chance we saw the letter "J," drove up there, and found it. Downstairs, there was a sign directing us to a tightly closed gate with no signage. The hotel itself is nice. There are outdoor pools on different floors. There's a free indoor heated pool, sauna, and hammam. The Indonesian staff can offer various massages for a fee. We booked a one-bedroom apartment. The living room has a fold-out sofa. My husband snores, so we thought he'd sleep in the living room and I in the bedroom. Unfortunately, there were no bedding for the sofa in the closets. The apartment has two bathrooms. One has a toilet and sink, the other has a toilet and shower. In one of them, it was impossible to go to the toilet—the toilet lid wouldn't stay up and kept falling on your back. In another, the door wouldn't close. Even if you're a couple with many years of experience, it's quite unpleasant to go to the toilet with the door open. The bed is comfortable, moderately soft. There's a TV with internet access. Large panoramic windows overlook the indoor pool. The windmills are not far away.

yorum: The hotel is a bit tired. We stayed in an apartment, which was quite large and had everything we needed.
